starting-out-talking-to-alec-kincade.speaker: Alec Kincade
starting-out-talking-to-alec-kincade.text: Greetings adventurer. Welcome to the Myths' Guild.

options.text: How can I gain access to the Guild?

steps.player: How can I gain access to the Guild?

steps.text: If the player does not meet all the requirements:

steps.speaker: Alec Kincade
steps.text: Only the most worthy may access our guild and I'm afraid you are not quite there yet. Go out and hone your skills. Then you can return to us.
You do not meet all of the requirements to start the Dragon Slayer II quest.
If the player meets all the requirements:

steps.speaker: Alec Kincade
steps.text: Only the most worthy are allowed access into the Myths' Guild. If you wish to enter, you'll need to prove yourself.

steps.player: How can I do that?

steps.speaker: Alec Kincade
steps.text: As time passes, that which was once fact, becomes myth. Some tales are just that, tales. However, some tales are something more.

steps.speaker: Alec Kincade
steps.text: Here at the Myths' Guild, we live to tell the difference between the two. If you wish to join us, you must do the same.

steps.player: So what myth would you like me to investigate?

steps.speaker: Alec Kincade
steps.text: For as long as history remembers, dragons have roamed these lands, but despite how long they've been here, much of their history remains hidden.

steps.speaker: Alec Kincade
steps.text: There are tales of course, but tales are not enough for us. We want you to discover the truth. Where did the dragons come from? Why are they here? Who do they serve?

steps.speaker: Alec Kincade
steps.text: Answer these questions for us. Help us fill our Library of Knowledge. In return, we will grant you access to the guild and you will reap the rewards within.

steps.speaker: Alec Kincade
steps.text: So, do you feel up for the challenge?

steps.player: Yes. Where should I begin?

steps.speaker: Alec Kincade
steps.text: Head to Karamja Wines, Spirits, and Beers at Musa Point. There you'll find Dallas Jones. We've heard that he is investigating the destruction of Crandor. This seems like a good place to start.

steps.speaker: Alec Kincade
steps.text: Good luck.

steps.player: No. This is too much for me.

steps.speaker: Alec Kincade
steps.text: As you wish. If you change your mind, you know where we are.

starting-out-talking-to-alec-kincade-tal.speaker: Alec Kincade
starting-out-talking-to-alec-kincade-tal.text: Greetings, adventurer. Welcome to the Myths' Guild.

steps.player: Let's talk about my quest.

steps.speaker: Alec Kincade
steps.text: How are things progressing?
Before reaching the Ancient Doors:

steps.player: I'm yet to discover anything.

steps.speaker: Alec Kincade
steps.text: Well return to us once you do. If you help us fill our Library of Knowledge, we shall grant you access to the guild.
Once the player reaches the point where they must find Bob the Cat:

steps.player: I'm investigating the origin of Elvarg. I've found some old doors on a ruined island, but they're locked. I think something important lies behind them.

steps.speaker: Alec Kincade
steps.text: Well keep at it. If you help us fill our Library of Knowledge, we shall grant you access to the guild.
Once the player recovers Bob's memories as Robert:

steps.player: I'm investigating the origin of Elvarg. I've found some old doors on a ruined island, but they're locked. I'm trying to find the key.

steps.speaker: Alec Kincade
steps.text: Well keep at it. If you help us fill our Library of Knowledge, we shall grant you access to the guild.
Once the player opens the Lithkren Vault:

steps.player: I'm investigating the origin of Elvarg. I've found an ancient vault beneath a ruined island. I think it contains something important.

steps.speaker: Alec Kincade
steps.text: Well you'd better investigate it then. If you help us fill our Library of Knowledge, we shall grant you access to the guild.
Once Zorgoth and Galvek escape from the vault:

steps.player: I was investigating the origin of Elvarg but I accidently released a dragonkin!

steps.speaker: Alec Kincade
steps.text: Well that can't be good. You'd better sort that out.

steps.player: I'm working on it.

starting-out-talking-to-dallas-jones.player: Hello there. I'm [player name]. Are you Dallas Jones?

starting-out-talking-to-dallas-jones.speaker: Dallas Jones
starting-out-talking-to-dallas-jones.text: I am. Pleased to meet you. I'm assuming you're here because of my advert?

starting-out-talking-to-dallas-jones.speaker: Dallas Jones
starting-out-talking-to-dallas-jones.text: Excellent! Let me run you through the details.

starting-out-talking-to-dallas-jones.speaker: Dallas Jones
starting-out-talking-to-dallas-jones.text: We're to head to Elvarg's lair beneath Crandor. There we will begin a research project on Elvarg and her attack on the island.

starting-out-talking-to-dallas-jones.speaker: Dallas Jones
starting-out-talking-to-dallas-jones.text: I trust you know the tale of Elvarg?

starting-out-talking-to-dallas-jones.player: Well I was the one who killed her in the first place.

starting-out-talking-to-dallas-jones.speaker: Dallas Jones
starting-out-talking-to-dallas-jones.text: You're the Hero of Crandor? Amazing!

starting-out-talking-to-dallas-jones.speaker: Dallas Jones
starting-out-talking-to-dallas-jones.text: I take it you know her story very well then?

steps.player: Remind me.

steps.speaker: Dallas Jones
steps.text: Thirty years ago, an adventurer descended into the caves beneath Crandor. There he discovered the dragon Elvarg.

steps.speaker: Dallas Jones
steps.text: Elvarg made short work of the adventurer. Once she was finished with him, she emerged from the caves and laid waste to the island.

steps.speaker: Dallas Jones
steps.text: For the next thirty years, Elvarg remained on Crandor until she was finally defeated, by you.

steps.speaker: Dallas Jones
steps.text: Now that Elvarg is dead, we have the opportunity to perform research on the island and investigate her attack.

steps.speaker: Dallas Jones
steps.text: Meet me in Elvarg's Lair beneath Crandor when you're ready to begin.

steps.player: Sounds good. See you there.
Yes I know it well.

steps.speaker: Dallas Jones
steps.text: Wonderful. I won't waste your time with it then.

steps.speaker: Dallas Jones
steps.text: Now that Elvarg is dead, we have the opportunity to perform research on the island and investigate her attack.

steps.speaker: Dallas Jones
steps.text: Meet me in Elvarg's Lair beneath Crandor when you're ready to begin.

steps.player: Sounds good. See you there.

starting-out-talking-to-dallas-in-elvarg.player: Hello, Dallas. So what exactly are we researching here?

starting-out-talking-to-dallas-in-elvarg.speaker: Dallas Jones
starting-out-talking-to-dallas-in-elvarg.text: Elvarg's attack on Crandor is a bit of an anomaly. We're here to work out why.

starting-out-talking-to-dallas-in-elvarg.speaker: Dallas Jones
starting-out-talking-to-dallas-in-elvarg.text: Elvarg is very unusual in that she is one of the few dragons to live alone. Most of her kind live in large groups.

starting-out-talking-to-dallas-in-elvarg.speaker: Dallas Jones
starting-out-talking-to-dallas-in-elvarg.text: Not only that, she also displayed far greater aggression than most other dragons by directly attacking Crandor.

starting-out-talking-to-dallas-in-elvarg.speaker: Dallas Jones
starting-out-talking-to-dallas-in-elvarg.text: Not like Elvarg was. Most dragons will only attack those who enter their territory. Elvarg strayed well outside of hers when she attacked the island.

starting-out-talking-to-dallas-in-elvarg.player: I see. Where should we start?

starting-out-talking-to-dallas-in-elvarg.speaker: Dallas Jones
starting-out-talking-to-dallas-in-elvarg.text: This is where Elvarg made her home. There must be something here to point us in the right direction. Have a look around and see what you can find.

steps.player: Let's talk about the investigation.

steps.speaker: Dallas Jones
steps.text: How are things going?

steps.player: I've found a strange wall that looks like it might have something behind it. We might be able to mine through it.

steps.speaker: Dallas Jones
steps.text: Good work. I'm afraid you'll need to be the one to do the mining. My back isn't what it once was.

steps.player: Tell me about yourself.

steps.speaker: Dallas Jones
steps.text: Not much to tell really. My name is Dallas Jones and I'm a researcher for the Varrock Museum. Many of the researchers have an area of expertise. Mine is dragons.

steps.player: Why dragons?

steps.speaker: Dallas Jones
steps.text: My father used to live on Crandor before it was destroyed. He was one of the many who were killed by Elvarg.

steps.speaker: Dallas Jones
steps.text: His death left me with a great interest in dragons and I've spent the last fifteen years trying to learn more about them.

steps.player: I see. Thanks, Dallas.
Let's talk about the investigation.

steps.speaker: Dallas Jones
steps.text: How are things going?

steps.player: I've mined through a strange wall and found a tunnel behind it.

steps.speaker: Dallas Jones
steps.text: I can see that. We could well be on to something here. You go through the tunnel and see if it's safe. I'll be right behind you.

starting-out-the-secret-laboratory.speaker: Dallas Jones
starting-out-the-secret-laboratory.text: Goodness me! What is this place?

starting-out-the-secret-laboratory.player: It looks like some sort of laboratory.

starting-out-the-secret-laboratory.speaker: Dallas Jones
starting-out-the-secret-laboratory.text: Are the tales true? Could this mean?

starting-out-the-secret-laboratory.speaker: Dallas Jones
starting-out-the-secret-laboratory.text: There are ancient tales that tell of the origin of the dragons. They say they were created by a powerful race of creatures known as the dragonkin.

starting-out-the-secret-laboratory.speaker: Dallas Jones
starting-out-the-secret-laboratory.text: Yes, you likely will have. We know for a fact that the dragonkin existed. They terrorised the world for many years during the early Fourth Age.

starting-out-the-secret-laboratory.speaker: Dallas Jones
starting-out-the-secret-laboratory.text: The thing is, despite their similar names, no actual connection between the dragonkin and the dragons has ever been proven.

starting-out-the-secret-laboratory.player: Well maybe we'll be the ones to prove it.

starting-out-the-secret-laboratory.speaker: Dallas Jones
starting-out-the-secret-laboratory.text: We might just be. We should look around and see what we can uncover.

steps.player: Let's talk about the investigation.

steps.speaker: Dallas Jones
steps.text: I just can't believe it. This place may not just hold the secrets of Elvarg, but of the whole dragon race!

steps.player: I'll look around and see what I can find.

starting-out-the-secret-laboratory-talki.speaker: Dallas Jones
starting-out-the-secret-laboratory-talki.text: How strange. We should keep looking around.

starting-out-the-secret-laboratory-inspe.text: The mural has images of dragons and fungi along with the word 'Lithkren'.
You find some notes next to the machinery.

starting-out-the-secret-laboratory-talki.player: I've found an old mural. It has lots of dragons and fungi on it along with some strange writing.
I don't know. It looked like a different language. It had odd words on it like 'Lithkren'.

starting-out-the-secret-laboratory-talki.speaker: Dallas Jones
starting-out-the-secret-laboratory-talki.text: Lithkren? That name sounds familiar. Where have I seen it before?

starting-out-the-secret-laboratory-talki.speaker: Dallas Jones
starting-out-the-secret-laboratory-talki.text: Of course! Fossil Island! I was there recently as part of the research team investigating the differences between wyverns and dragons.

starting-out-the-secret-laboratory-talki.speaker: Dallas Jones
starting-out-the-secret-laboratory-talki.text: There's an old settlement on the island with similar architecture to this place. It contains lots of books, many written in a strange language. One of the books mentioned a place called Lithkren.
If the player has read the ancient diary:

steps.player: You know, now that you mention it, I think I may have read that book as well.

steps.speaker: Dallas Jones
steps.text: Well that just confirms it! Not to mention that Fossil Island is also coated in various types of fungi. It must be connected!

starting-out-the-secret-laboratory-talki.text: If the player has not read the ancient diary:

steps.speaker: Dallas Jones
steps.text: Fossil Island is also coated in various types of fungi. It must be connected!

starting-out-the-secret-laboratory-talki.player: In that case, we should probably go to Fossil Island.

starting-out-the-secret-laboratory-talki.speaker: Dallas Jones
starting-out-the-secret-laboratory-talki.text: I agree. Head to the old settlement on the north side of the island. I'll meet you there once I've finished up here.

starting-out-the-secret-laboratory-talki.speaker: Dallas Jones
starting-out-the-secret-laboratory-talki.text: It looks like we've found everything here. We should move on to Fossil Island. I'll meet you at the old settlement on the north side of the island.

the-house-on-the-hill-talking-to-dallas.speaker: Dallas Jones
the-house-on-the-hill-talking-to-dallas.text: So while I was waiting for you, I had a look through these books again. One of them mentions a nearby island called Lithkren. Thing is, there are lots of islands around here. It doesn't say which one it is.
If the player has read the ancient diary:

steps.player: So how do we know which island to go to?

steps.speaker: Dallas Jones
steps.text: Have a look at this grid on the floor. I think it might actually be a map. If you look at that tile in the middle, it looks like part of this island.

steps.player: Hmm... So this map could lead us to Lithkren. Most of the pieces are missing though.

steps.speaker: Dallas Jones
steps.text: That they are. However, I had a look around and I managed to find some of the pieces.
Dallas shows you some of the map pieces.

steps.speaker: Dallas Jones
steps.text: By my calculations, there are 24 pieces left to find. I suspect they'll either be in this building or very close by.

steps.player: Great! I'll have a look around and see if I can find them.

steps.speaker: Dallas Jones
steps.text: Good luck. Once you have all of the pieces, bring them here and we'll see about putting this map together.

the-house-on-the-hill-talking-to-dallas.text: If the player has not read the ancient diary:

options.text: So how do we know which island to go to?

steps.player: Which book was it?

steps.speaker: Dallas Jones
steps.text: Check the pile behind the ladder. You should find it there.

steps.player: So how do we know which island to go to?
Let's talk about the investigation.

steps.speaker: Dallas Jones
steps.text: Have you managed to find those map pieces yet?
If the player does not have map pieces on them:

steps.player: Not yet.

steps.speaker: Dallas Jones
steps.text: Well keep looking. We have [amount] pieces left to find. I suspect they'll either be in this building or very close by.

steps.player: Yes. I have some here.

steps.speaker: Dallas Jones
steps.text: Great. I'll look after them for you.
If there are more pieces to find:

steps.player: Is that all of them?

steps.speaker: Dallas Jones
steps.text: Not yet. We have [amount] pieces left to find. I suspect they'll either be in this building or very close by.
If there are no more pieces to find:

steps.player: I think that's all of them.

steps.speaker: Dallas Jones
steps.text: It looks like it is. Good job.

steps.speaker: Dallas Jones
steps.text: Now then, shall we see about finishing this map?

steps.player: Let's do it!
Not right now.

steps.speaker: Dallas Jones
steps.text: Fair enough. Let me know when you're ready.

the-house-on-the-hill-finishing-the-map.speaker: Dallas Jones
the-house-on-the-hill-finishing-the-map.text: I do believe you've got it! Yes, we should be able to find Lithkren now.

the-house-on-the-hill-finishing-the-map.speaker: Dallas Jones
the-house-on-the-hill-finishing-the-map.text: There's a strange symbol on the map in two places. One marks this building and the other marks an island. I bet that's Lithkren.

the-house-on-the-hill-finishing-the-map.player: I think you might be right. So now that we know where the island is, we need to find a way there. Do you think the museum can help us?

the-house-on-the-hill-finishing-the-map.speaker: Dallas Jones
the-house-on-the-hill-finishing-the-map.text: The museum? No that won't work. Any requisition of museum resources requires a mountain of paperwork and we simply don't have time.

the-house-on-the-hill-finishing-the-map.speaker: Dallas Jones
the-house-on-the-hill-finishing-the-map.text: Of course not! Besides, I've spent years working towards this and I'm tired of waiting. It's time to discover the truth.

the-house-on-the-hill-finishing-the-map.player: Alright, alright. So what do we do instead?

the-house-on-the-hill-finishing-the-map.speaker: Dallas Jones
the-house-on-the-hill-finishing-the-map.text: We'll need a boat. Find a dwarf called Jardric. He should be somewhere on the island. He's an old friend who owes me a favour. He should be able to get a boat for us.

the-house-on-the-hill-finishing-the-map.speaker: Dallas Jones
the-house-on-the-hill-finishing-the-map.text: While you're doing that, I'm going to take a copy of this map.

the-house-on-the-hill-finishing-the-map-.player: What should I be doing again?

the-house-on-the-hill-finishing-the-map-.speaker: Dallas Jones
the-house-on-the-hill-finishing-the-map-.text: We'll need a boat to get to Lithkren. Jardric should be able to help us. See if you can find him. He should be somewhere on the island.

to-lithkren-talking-to-jardric.speaker: Jardric
to-lithkren-talking-to-jardric.text: That I am. Former boatman and now a researcher for Keldagrim. What can I do for you?

to-lithkren-talking-to-jardric.player: I'm working with Dallas Jones on a research project. We're investigating the destruction of Crandor. We need a boat to get to one of the nearby islands. Dallas said you could help us.

to-lithkren-talking-to-jardric.speaker: Jardric
to-lithkren-talking-to-jardric.text: Did he now? Looking to cash in on that favour I bet. I'm afraid I can't help you. All the boats around here are owned by the museum and they won't just let you take them.

to-lithkren-talking-to-jardric.speaker: Jardric
to-lithkren-talking-to-jardric.text: Of course, Dallas works with the museum and he could easily put in a request for one, but he's not a fan of waiting around...

to-lithkren-talking-to-jardric.player: He said as much. So what can we do?

to-lithkren-talking-to-jardric.speaker: Jardric
to-lithkren-talking-to-jardric.text: Well I suppose you could always build your own. If the island isn't far you'll only need a small rowboat.

to-lithkren-talking-to-jardric.speaker: Jardric
to-lithkren-talking-to-jardric.text: Mind you, you'll want to be quite good at building things, unless you fancy a trip to the bottom of the ocean.

to-lithkren-talking-to-jardric.player: I'm not actually too bad when it comes to construction. What will I need?

to-lithkren-talking-to-jardric.speaker: Jardric
to-lithkren-talking-to-jardric.text: Let's see... I'd say eight oak planks, ten swamp paste and 12 nails of any kind should do it. Obviously you'll need a hammer and a saw too.

to-lithkren-talking-to-jardric.speaker: Jardric
to-lithkren-talking-to-jardric.text: You'll probably be wanting someone to look after the boat as well. I guess I can do that. But this means that Dallas and I are even.

to-lithkren-talking-to-jardric.speaker: Jardric
to-lithkren-talking-to-jardric.text: There should be a good spot to build the boat on the west side of the island, near the mushroom forest.

to-lithkren-talking-to-jardric-talking-t.speaker: Jardric
to-lithkren-talking-to-jardric-talking-t.text: Hello again. How's the boat coming along?

to-lithkren-talking-to-jardric-talking-t.speaker: Jardric
to-lithkren-talking-to-jardric-talking-t.text: You'll need a saw, a hammer, eight oak planks, ten swamp paste and 12 nails of any kind. The best place to build the boat will be on the west side of the island, near the mushroom forest.

to-lithkren-talking-to-jardric-at-the-ro.speaker: Jardric
to-lithkren-talking-to-jardric-at-the-ro.text: Hello again. This should be a good place to build the boat.

to-lithkren-talking-to-jardric-at-the-ro.speaker: Jardric
to-lithkren-talking-to-jardric-at-the-ro.text: You'll need a saw, a hammer, eight oak planks, ten swamp paste and 12 nails of any kind.

to-lithkren-talking-to-dallas-at-the-row.speaker: Dallas Jones
to-lithkren-talking-to-dallas-at-the-row.text: Hello again. How's the boat coming along?

to-lithkren-talking-to-dallas-at-the-row.speaker: Dallas Jones
to-lithkren-talking-to-dallas-at-the-row.text: Well talk to Jardric if you need some help. He'll know what to do.

to-lithkren-talking-to-dallas-at-the-row.speaker: Jardric
to-lithkren-talking-to-dallas-at-the-row.text: And not a bad boat either. Good job.

to-lithkren-talking-to-dallas-at-the-row.speaker: Dallas Jones
to-lithkren-talking-to-dallas-at-the-row.text: This is it. This is our chance to finally find some answers. To finally find out the truth behind Elvarg. Are you ready to go?

steps.player: I'm ready.

steps.speaker: Dallas Jones
steps.text: Look at this place! I'm going to explore and see what I can find.
Dallas departs to explore the island.

steps.player: Someone's in a hurry. I suppose I should look around as well.

steps.speaker: Jardric
steps.text: And I guess I'll stay here and look after the boat. Good luck.

steps.player: Not yet.

steps.speaker: Dallas Jones
steps.text: Well don't take too long. We've had to wait years for this. I don't want to wait much longer.

to-lithkren-talking-to-dallas-at-the-anc.player: Well those are some big doors.

to-lithkren-talking-to-dallas-at-the-anc.speaker: Dallas Jones
to-lithkren-talking-to-dallas-at-the-anc.text: Look at them. Look at the markings on them.

to-lithkren-talking-to-dallas-at-the-anc.speaker: Dallas Jones
to-lithkren-talking-to-dallas-at-the-anc.text: Exactly. This is it. This has to be the place.

to-lithkren-talking-to-dallas-at-the-anc.speaker: Dallas Jones
to-lithkren-talking-to-dallas-at-the-anc.text: We can't. I already tried, but the doors are sealed. There's a circular indentation in the middle. Maybe it's a keyhole.

to-lithkren-talking-to-dallas-at-the-anc.player: Well a keyhole isn't much good if there isn't a key. We should look around and see if there are any clues nearby.

to-lithkren-searching-the-charred-skelet.text: You find an old book next to the skeleton.

to-lithkren-talking-to-dallas-after-find.text: If the player has not read Aivas' diary:

steps.player: I found an old diary nearby but I haven't read it yet.

steps.speaker: Dallas Jones
steps.text: Well read it and see what it says. It could well contain the information we need.

to-lithkren-talking-to-dallas-after-find.text: If the player has read Aivas' diary:

steps.player: I found an old diary nearby but I haven't read it yet.

steps.speaker: Dallas Jones
steps.text: Well read it and see what it says. It could well contain the information we need.

steps.speaker: Dallas Jones
steps.text: Any luck?

steps.player: I found an old diary nearby. It mentioned a battle that took place here involving Robert the Strong.

steps.speaker: Dallas Jones
steps.text: Robert the Strong? He spent most of his life fighting the dragonkin. Does this mean it's true? Did they really create the dragons?

steps.speaker: Dallas Jones
steps.text: I guess we'll never know though. Robert the Strong is gone. We've reached a dead end.

steps.player: Not necessarily. Robert the Strong might not be as dead as you think.

steps.speaker: Dallas Jones
steps.text: What do you mean?

steps.player: Robert the Strong is still alive. He's been reincarnated as a cat called Bob.

steps.speaker: Dallas Jones
steps.text: Just think once before you speak please.

steps.player: I'm serious! Why would I lie about this?

steps.speaker: Dallas Jones
steps.text: Well I'm definitely not convinced, but let's say you're telling the truth... how can a cat help us?

steps.player: I have an amulet that lets me talk to cats. I can use it to ask Bob what he knows.

steps.speaker: Dallas Jones
steps.text: This is all very confusing. You go find this cat of yours. I need to sit down and clear my head of all this weirdness.

steps.player: Very well. I shall return once I've learnt more.

to-lithkren-talking-to-dallas-after-find.speaker: Dallas Jones
to-lithkren-talking-to-dallas-after-find.text: Hello. Have you found that cat yet?

to-lithkren-talking-to-dallas-after-find.player: Not yet I'm afraid. He likes to move around a lot.

to-lithkren-talking-to-dallas-after-find.speaker: Dallas Jones
to-lithkren-talking-to-dallas-after-find.text: Well keep at it. We need to get through these doors.

bob-the-cat-talking-to-bob.player: Not bad. I was wondering if you could help me with something.

bob-the-cat-talking-to-bob.speaker: Bob
bob-the-cat-talking-to-bob.text: I guess that depends what it is.

bob-the-cat-talking-to-bob.player: So you know how you're actually Robert the Strong?

bob-the-cat-talking-to-bob.speaker: Bob
bob-the-cat-talking-to-bob.text: So you and the Sphinx tell me.

bob-the-cat-talking-to-bob.player: Long story, I'll keep it brief. I found an old dungeon with a large set of doors in it. There was a skeleton nearby with a diary that mentioned Robert the Strong.
I was hoping you could use your memories of Robert the Strong to help me open the doors.

bob-the-cat-talking-to-bob.speaker: Bob
bob-the-cat-talking-to-bob.text: But I don't have any memories of Robert the Strong. It was only when the Sphinx hypnotised me that we learnt who I really was and I don't even remember that.

bob-the-cat-talking-to-bob.player: Maybe the Sphinx can help us again.

bob-the-cat-talking-to-bob.speaker: Bob

bob-the-cat-talking-to-bob.speaker: Bob

bob-the-cat-talking-to-bob.speaker: Bob

steps.speaker: Bob

steps.player: Thing?

steps.speaker: Sphinx

steps.speaker: Sphinx

steps.player: I'm very honoured.

steps.speaker: Sphinx

steps.speaker: Sphinx
steps.text: All done. Now, what is it you need my help with?

steps.player: We were hoping you could hypnotise Bob again so we can learn more about his past.

steps.speaker: Sphinx

steps.player: It's about that dungeon. I believe that it was once visited by Robert the Strong. I want to know what he did while he was there.

steps.speaker: Sphinx

steps.speaker: Bob
steps.text: What are you thinking, [player name]?

steps.player: I once entered the mind of a guy called Cyrisus to confront some personal issues of his. The Oneiromancer on Lunar Isle helped me do it. Maybe she can help us now.

steps.speaker: Bob

robert-the-strong-talking-to-bob-on-luna.speaker: Bob
robert-the-strong-talking-to-bob-on-luna.text: Hello again, [player name]. The Oneiromancer and I were just discussing what our perfect Sunday would be.

robert-the-strong-talking-to-bob-on-luna.player: I didn't know you two knew each other. Also, how can you speak to cats?

steps.player: Huh... small world.

robert-the-strong-talking-to-bob-on-luna.player: We need to unlock Bob's memories from his old life as Robert the Strong. We were hoping that we could use a shared dream.

robert-the-strong-inside-bob-s-dream.speaker: Bob

robert-the-strong-inside-bob-s-dream.speaker: Not Bob

robert-the-strong-inside-bob-s-dream.speaker: Bob

robert-the-strong-inside-bob-s-dream.speaker: Not Bob
robert-the-strong-inside-bob-s-dream.text: You tell me. It's your mind we're in right now.

robert-the-strong-inside-bob-s-dream.player: We're here to recover Bob's lost memories from his life as Robert the Strong. Do you think you can help us?

robert-the-strong-inside-bob-s-dream.speaker: Not Bob
robert-the-strong-inside-bob-s-dream.text: I suppose I can. This barrier represents the divide between Bob the Cat and Robert the Strong. The memories you seek are right here, on the other side of the barrier.

robert-the-strong-inside-bob-s-dream.speaker: Bob
robert-the-strong-inside-bob-s-dream.text: So all we need to do is go through the barrier?

robert-the-strong-inside-bob-s-dream.speaker: Not Bob
robert-the-strong-inside-bob-s-dream.text: Going through the barrier will give you access to Robert's memories, but only while you're in the dream. As soon as you leave, you'll forget them again.

robert-the-strong-inside-bob-s-dream.player: So how can we permanently unlock them?

robert-the-strong-inside-bob-s-dream.speaker: Bob
robert-the-strong-inside-bob-s-dream.text: Defeat the guardian? I'm no good at combat... I'm a cat.

robert-the-strong-inside-bob-s-dream.speaker: Not Bob
robert-the-strong-inside-bob-s-dream.text: Good job this is a shared dream then. It doesn't have to be you that defeats him.

robert-the-strong-inside-bob-s-dream.player: Looks like it's up to me then. Wish me luck.

robert-the-strong-inside-bob-s-dream-tal.player: What should I be doing again?

robert-the-strong-inside-bob-s-dream-tal.speaker: Bob
robert-the-strong-inside-bob-s-dream-tal.text: Apparently you need to defeat the guardian on the other side of this barrier. Sounds odd to me, but what do I know.

robert-the-strong-inside-bob-s-dream-tal.player: What am I meant to be doing again?

robert-the-strong-inside-bob-s-dream-tal.speaker: Not Bob
robert-the-strong-inside-bob-s-dream-tal.text: Pass through the barrier and defeat the guardian. That should restore Bob's lost memories.

robert-the-strong-robert-s-memories.speaker: Bob
robert-the-strong-robert-s-memories.text: I remember! Lithkren! The dragonkin! The vault!
Flashback starts

robert-the-strong-robert-s-memories.speaker: Dragonkin
robert-the-strong-robert-s-memories.text: Robert! I should have known that this would be your doing.

robert-the-strong-robert-s-memories.speaker: Robert the Strong
robert-the-strong-robert-s-memories.text: It's over dragonkin. The island is ours. You have lost.

robert-the-strong-robert-s-memories.speaker: Dragonkin
robert-the-strong-robert-s-memories.text: Lost? This is no more than a minor setback. The work we have done here will see the end of your kind. You are too late to stop it.

robert-the-strong-robert-s-memories.speaker: Aivas
robert-the-strong-robert-s-memories.text: And what work might that be?

robert-the-strong-robert-s-memories.speaker: Dragonkin
robert-the-strong-robert-s-memories.text: Our new weapon. One that will bring a swift end to humanity. I'd love to be able to show you, but I'm afraid I have more pressing matters.

robert-the-strong-robert-s-memories.speaker: Camorra
robert-the-strong-robert-s-memories.text: Like dying perhaps?

robert-the-strong-robert-s-memories.speaker: Dragonkin
robert-the-strong-robert-s-memories.text: You'd like that, wouldn't you? Alas, I'm afraid that I won't be the one that dies today.

robert-the-strong-robert-s-memories.speaker: Tristan
robert-the-strong-robert-s-memories.text: We'll see about that.

robert-the-strong-robert-s-memories.speaker: Dragonkin
robert-the-strong-robert-s-memories.text: Yes we will, for this is where it begins.

robert-the-strong-robert-s-memories.speaker: Robert the Strong
robert-the-strong-robert-s-memories.text: No. This is where it ends.
The heroes begin to fight the dragonkin. Aivas is killed instantly upon the dragonkin attacking him.

robert-the-strong-robert-s-memories.speaker: Tristan
robert-the-strong-robert-s-memories.text: Aivas!

robert-the-strong-robert-s-memories.speaker: Camorra
robert-the-strong-robert-s-memories.text: You'll pay for that!
The heroes continue the assault, eventually defeating the dragonkin, who drops a dragon key.

robert-the-strong-robert-s-memories.speaker: Tristan
robert-the-strong-robert-s-memories.text: What is that?

robert-the-strong-robert-s-memories.speaker: Robert the Strong
robert-the-strong-robert-s-memories.text: Looks like some sort of key. For these doors I assume.

robert-the-strong-robert-s-memories.speaker: Camorra
robert-the-strong-robert-s-memories.text: Should we open them?

robert-the-strong-robert-s-memories.speaker: Robert the Strong
robert-the-strong-robert-s-memories.text: No. That dragonkin mentioned a weapon. One that could destroy us all. Better something like that remains hidden... for now.
Robert picks up the key, and the flashback ends.

robert-the-strong-robert-s-memories.speaker: Bob
robert-the-strong-robert-s-memories.text: I've got a lot to take in and understand, but I'm okay.

robert-the-strong-robert-s-memories.player: So do you have all of your memories back now?

robert-the-strong-robert-s-memories.speaker: Bob
robert-the-strong-robert-s-memories.text: Yes and no. I now have my old memories again, but there are so many of them. I can't quite piece them all together yet. I need time to properly work things out.

robert-the-strong-robert-s-memories.speaker: Bob
robert-the-strong-robert-s-memories.text: However, one thing that I do remember clearly is that battle. I also remember what happened next.

robert-the-strong-robert-s-memories.speaker: Bob
robert-the-strong-robert-s-memories.text: After the battle, myself, Tristan and Camorra split the key into four pieces. We vowed to ensure that the dragonkin would never recover them, and to only return once the war was won.

robert-the-strong-robert-s-memories.speaker: Bob
robert-the-strong-robert-s-memories.text: No. In the end, we went our seperate ways. Of the four pieces, Camorra took one, Tristan took another and I took the final two.

robert-the-strong-robert-s-memories.speaker: Bob
robert-the-strong-robert-s-memories.text: Camorra eventually boarded a ship for lands to the far west, never to be seen again. She took her key piece with her.

robert-the-strong-robert-s-memories.speaker: Bob
robert-the-strong-robert-s-memories.text: Tristan passed his piece on to his descendants. They lived in the city of Saranthium, where Varrock now stands. Perhaps the Varrock Library has some record of them.

robert-the-strong-robert-s-memories.speaker: Bob
robert-the-strong-robert-s-memories.text: I hid one of my pieces in the most unlikely of places, an abandoned dragonkin fortress. You'll find the fortress on a snow covered island, north west of Rellekka.

robert-the-strong-robert-s-memories.speaker: Bob
robert-the-strong-robert-s-memories.text: The final piece I took to Karamja. I hid it in an ancient temple on the south coast of the island.

robert-the-strong-robert-s-memories.player: Sounds like I have a fair amount of work to do. Thanks, Bob.

robert-the-strong-robert-s-memories.speaker: Bob
robert-the-strong-robert-s-memories.text: With the dragonkin long gone, the vault should be safe to open. That said, you should still be cautious, [player name].

robert-the-strong-robert-s-memories.speaker: Bob
robert-the-strong-robert-s-memories.text: The scars of our war with the dragonkin remain to this day, and the weapon in that vault could still be very dangerous.

robert-the-strong-robert-s-memories-talk.player: Hi, Bob. Could you remind me where those key pieces are?

robert-the-strong-robert-s-memories-talk.speaker: Bob

steps.text: Hand it over then.
You hand the orb to Ava.

steps.speaker: Ava
steps.text: Excellent. Now just a few small adjustments and...
Ava gives you the finished locator orb.

steps.speaker: Ava
steps.text: Here you go. You can use this to track down that key piece of yours.

steps.player: Great! How does it work?

steps.speaker: Ava
steps.text: The orb will pull you in the direction of the key piece, but be careful with it. It's a little unstable.

steps.player: Awesome! That's just... Wait... what do you mean unstable?

steps.speaker: Ava
steps.text: Nothing to get worried about. It might just sting a bit when you use it.

steps.player: Er... great? Anyway, before I go I was wondering...

steps.speaker: Ava
steps.text: If I could upgrade that device of yours?

steps.player: Well now that you mention it...

steps.speaker: Ava
steps.text: Hmm... Might be possible. The chicken is the weakness at the moment. If you find something with a bit more kick, I might be able to upgrade it further.

steps.player: Bit more kick?

steps.speaker: Ava
steps.text: Yes. Something a bit stronger. A bit more undead.

steps.player: Okay... Thanks for the help Ava. See you later.

options.text: I'd like to see your stuff for sale, please.
I'll just head off, I think.

tristan-s-key-piece-talking-to-ava-after.speaker: Ava
tristan-s-key-piece-talking-to-ava-after.text: Hello again. Are you after another device, or some information, or would you like to see my goods for sale?

options.text: I need your help with a key piece.

steps.player: I need your help with a key piece.

If the player has an orb already:
