If the player lost their orb:

steps.player: Don't get mad.

steps.speaker: Ava
steps.text: You lost it, didn't you?

steps.player: Yeah...

steps.speaker: Ava
steps.text: Well luckily for you, I made a spare. Please try to look after this one.
Ava gives you a locator orb.

options.text: I'd like to see your stuff for sale, please.
I'll just head off, I think.

robert-s-karamjan-key-piece-talking-to-g.speaker: Gujuo
robert-s-karamjan-key-piece-talking-to-g.text: Good day, Bwana. The Kharazi jungle is especially beautiful today, isn't it?

options.text: I'm looking for an ancient temple.

steps.player: I'm looking for an ancient temple.

steps.speaker: Gujuo
steps.text: A temple? There's an old dungeon in the south east corner of the jungle. Could this be what you seek, Bwana?

steps.player: It may well be. Thanks for the help.

steps.speaker: Gujuo
steps.text: I must warn you, Bwana, that place is dangous. Many of our people have entered and never returned.

steps.player: It can never be easy can it? Okay, I'll be careful. Thanks again.

options.text: I've lost the totem pole you gave me.

robert-s-karamjan-key-piece-talking-to-g.speaker: Gujuo
robert-s-karamjan-key-piece-talking-to-g.text: Good day, Bwana. The Kharazi jungle is especially beautiful today, isn't it?

options.text: I'm looking for an ancient temple.

steps.player: I'm looking for an ancient temple.

steps.speaker: Gujuo
steps.text: Did you try that dungeon in the south east corner of the jungle, Bwana?

steps.player: I didn't. I'll look there. Thank you.

options.text: I've lost the totem pole you gave me.
Ask about a Seal of Passage.

steps.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
steps.text: Greetings, [Fremennik name]. How are things?

steps.player: Hello, Brundt. I wanted to ask you about something.

steps.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
steps.text: Well ask away, [Fremennik name].

steps.player: Apparently there's an island north of here with an ancient fortress on it. Have you heard of it?

steps.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
steps.text: I think I know of this island. Ungael, we call it. It is a dark place, guarded by a deadly beast. Some of our finest warriors tried to take the beast down, but to no success.

steps.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
steps.text: Do you intend to slay this beast for yourself, [Fremennik name]?

steps.player: Er... yes, I think I do.

steps.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
steps.text: This is no easy task, [Fremennik name], but glory awaits you if you succeed.

steps.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
steps.text: Go see Torfinn on the docks. He can take you to Ungael. Good luck, [Fremennik name].
If the player is exiled:

steps.player: Will he talk to me while I'm exiled?

steps.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
steps.text: He should do. Just tell him I sent you.

options.text: Ask about a Seal of Passage.

steps.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
steps.text: Greetings, [Fremennik name]. Have you destroyed that beast yet?

steps.player: Not yet.

steps.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
steps.text: Well if you speak to Torfinn on the docks he will take you to Ungael. Good luck, [Fremennik name].

robert-s-ungael-key-piece-talking-to-tor.text: If the player is not exiled:

steps.speaker: Torfinn
steps.text: Good day to you, [Fremennik name]. How can I help you?

steps.player: The chieftain says you can take me to Ungael.

steps.speaker: Torfinn
steps.text: That I can. You should know though, Ungael is a dangerous place. It is guarded by a deadly foe, one that spits fire at its enemies.

steps.speaker: Torfinn
steps.text: I shouldn't really be talking to you [Fremennik name].

steps.player: I know but the Chieftain says you can take me to Ungael.

steps.speaker: Torfinn
steps.text: Well if the Chieftain says it's okay then I guess I can. You should know though, Ungael is a dangerous place. It is guarded by a deadly force, one that spits fire at its enemies.

steps.player: Spits fire? Sounds like some sort of fire protection might be useful.

steps.speaker: Torfinn
steps.text: So, [Fremennik name], are you ready to go to Ungael?

steps.player: I'm ready.

steps.speaker: Torfinn
steps.text: Then we shall go.
The player is transported to Ungael

steps.player: Not yet.

steps.speaker: Torfinn
steps.text: I will be here when you are.

robert-s-ungael-key-piece-talking-to-tor.text: If the player is not exiled:

steps.speaker: Torfinn
steps.text: Good day to you, [Fremennik name]. Do you want to go to Ungael?

steps.speaker: Torfinn
steps.text: I'm not meant to be talking to you [Fremennik name]. I guess I can still take you to Ungael though if you want.

steps.player: Yes please.
No thank you.

camorra-s-key-piece-talking-to-veos-cabi.speaker: Veos
camorra-s-key-piece-talking-to-veos-cabi.text: Hey there! Do you need something?

options.text: Have you ever heard of Camorra?

steps.player: Have you ever heard of Camorra?

steps.speaker: Veos
steps.text: Camorra? What's a Camorra?

steps.player: She was an ancient hero who lived about two thousand years ago. I believe she travelled here at some point.

steps.speaker: Veos
steps.text: An ancient hero? Sounds like the Library Historical Archive is where you want to be. Talk to Archeio in the Arceuus Library. He can take you there.

steps.player: Great. Thank you.

camorra-s-key-piece-talking-to-veos-cabi.speaker: Veos
camorra-s-key-piece-talking-to-veos-cabi.text: Hey there! Do you need something?

options.text: Have you ever heard of Camorra?

steps.player: Have you ever heard of Camorra?

steps.speaker: Veos
steps.text: I'm afraid not. Did you try the Library Historical Archive?

steps.player: Not yet.

steps.speaker: Veos
steps.text: I suggest you try there. Talk to Archeio in the Arceuus Library. He can take you there.

steps.player: Thank you.

camorra-s-key-piece-talking-to-istoria.speaker: Istoria
camorra-s-key-piece-talking-to-istoria.text: Welcome to the Library Historical Archive.

options.text: Do you know anything about Camorra?

steps.player: Do you know anything about Camorra?

steps.speaker: Istoria
steps.text: I think I have heard that name before. Who is she?

steps.player: She was a hero who lived around two thousand years ago.

steps.speaker: Istoria
steps.text: I see. We have very few records from before the founding of Kourend. That said, perhaps Imerominia could help you? As a horologist, such ancient topics may fall within her purview.

steps.player: Thanks.

steps.speaker: Istoria
steps.text: Is there something else I can help you with?

options.text: How do I get out of here?

camorra-s-key-piece-talking-to-imeromini.player: Hello. What do you do here?

camorra-s-key-piece-talking-to-imeromini.speaker: Imerominia
camorra-s-key-piece-talking-to-imeromini.text: Hello. My name is Imerominia and I'm the library horologist.

options.text: Have you ever heard of Camorra?

steps.player: Have you ever heard of Camorra?

steps.speaker: Imerominia
steps.text: I can't say I have. Who is she?

steps.player: She's a hero from around two thousand years ago. I believe she travelled to Kourend during the Dragonkin Conflicts. I was hoping to learn more about her.

steps.speaker: Imerominia
steps.text: Two thousand years ago? That's long before the founding of Kourend. I'm afraid we have very few records from those times here.

steps.player: Oh. So you can't help me?

steps.speaker: Imerominia
steps.text: I can't, but someone might be able to. The five cities of Kourend were founded long before the kingdom itself. Each city has their own historian who might have more information on the early days of their city.

steps.player: Great. Is there a particular city you'd recommend?

steps.speaker: Imerominia
steps.text: Hosidius and Shayzien were the two cities founded during the Dragonkin Conflicts. They might be the best ones to start with. The other cities were founded much earlier, during the God Wars.

steps.player: Where can I find the Hosidius and Shayzien historians?

steps.speaker: Imerominia
steps.text: Jonathan is the Hosidius historian. He lives west of the Hosidius General Store. Amelia is the Shayzien historian. She lives south west of the Shayzien Pub.

steps.player: Thanks for the help.

camorra-s-key-piece-talking-to-imeromini.player: Hello. What do you do here?

camorra-s-key-piece-talking-to-imeromini.speaker: Imerominia
camorra-s-key-piece-talking-to-imeromini.text: Hello. My name is Imerominia and I'm the library horologist.

options.text: Have you ever heard of Camorra?

steps.player: Have you ever heard of Camorra?

steps.speaker: Imerominia
steps.text: I have not. Did you try talking to the Hosidius and Shayzien historians about her.

steps.player: Where can I find them again?

steps.speaker: Imerominia
steps.text: Jonathan is the Hosidius historian. He lives west of the Hosidius General Store. Amelia is the Shayzien historian. She lives south west of the Shayzien Pub.

steps.player: Thanks.

camorra-s-key-piece-talking-to-jonathan.player: Hello there. Have you heard of Camorra?
Camorra. She was a great hero who fought in the Dragonkin Conflicts. I think she travelled to Kourend during the war. I'm trying to find out what happened to her.

camorra-s-key-piece-talking-to-jonathan.speaker: Jonathan
camorra-s-key-piece-talking-to-jonathan.text: A hero? Well she wouldn't have had much to do with Hosidius. The early Hosidius settlers were all pacificts. They'd have stayed away from people like her.

camorra-s-key-piece-talking-to-jonathan.player: Oh well. Thanks for the help.

camorra-s-key-piece-talking-to-amelia.player: Well she was a great hero during the Dragonkin Conflicts. I think she travelled to Kourend before the war ended. I'm trying to find out more about her.

camorra-s-key-piece-talking-to-amelia.speaker: Amelia
camorra-s-key-piece-talking-to-amelia.text: Well Shayzien was founded by those fleeing the Dragonkin Conflicts, and the city has never been short of heroes. There's a good chance she was connected to Shayzien in some way.

camorra-s-key-piece-talking-to-amelia.player: But you've never heard of her?

camorra-s-key-piece-talking-to-amelia.speaker: Amelia
camorra-s-key-piece-talking-to-amelia.text: No, but that's not surprising. Much of our history was lost during Xeric's reign. However, there is somewhere you might find answers.

camorra-s-key-piece-talking-to-amelia.speaker: Amelia
camorra-s-key-piece-talking-to-amelia.text: The Shayzien Crypts. They were built before the kingdom even existed. Some of the oldest Shayzien heroes are buried there.

camorra-s-key-piece-talking-to-amelia.player: Let me guess... there's a catch isn't there?

camorra-s-key-piece-talking-to-amelia.speaker: Amelia
camorra-s-key-piece-talking-to-amelia.text: I'm afraid so. For hundreds of years, the crypts have been overrun by the dead. We've tried clearing them out, but they just come back again.

camorra-s-key-piece-talking-to-amelia.player: Well thankfully I ain't afraid of no ghosts. Where do I start?

camorra-s-key-piece-talking-to-amelia.speaker: Amelia
camorra-s-key-piece-talking-to-amelia.text: They're zombies and skeletons, not ghosts. You'll find the entrance to the crypts in the Graveyard of Heroes, west of here. Be careful.

camorra-s-key-piece-talking-to-amelia-ta.player: Hello there. Have you heard of Camorra?

camorra-s-key-piece-talking-to-amelia-ta.speaker: Amelia
camorra-s-key-piece-talking-to-amelia-ta.text: I'm sure we've already spoken about this.

camorra-s-key-piece-talking-to-amelia-ta.player: We probably have. I'm very forgetful.

camorra-s-key-piece-talking-to-amelia-ta.speaker: Amelia
camorra-s-key-piece-talking-to-amelia-ta.text: The most likely place to find answers is the Shayzien Crypts. You'll find the entrance in the Graveyard of Heroes, west of here. Be careful, it's filled with zombies and skeletons.

steps.text: You successfully remake the key.

the-ultimate-weapon-before-forging-the-k.speaker: Dallas Jones
the-ultimate-weapon-before-forging-the-k.text: So while you were gone, Bob popped up! I remembered you mentioning an amulet, so I managed to get myself one. Bob's taught me so much about the dragonkin! How are things going with you?

the-ultimate-weapon-before-forging-the-k.player: I've managed to recover the four key pieces, but I still need to reforge the key.

the-ultimate-weapon-before-forging-the-k.speaker: Bob
the-ultimate-weapon-before-forging-the-k.text: That key is made out of orikalkum. You won't have much luck with a normal furnace. You'll need something hotter.

the-ultimate-weapon-before-forging-the-k.speaker: Bob
the-ultimate-weapon-before-forging-the-k.text: There is a forge built by the dragonkin. They used it to make weapons out of orikalkum.

the-ultimate-weapon-before-forging-the-k.player: Do you remember where it is?

the-ultimate-weapon-before-forging-the-k.speaker: Bob
the-ultimate-weapon-before-forging-the-k.text: I'm afraid not. My memories are still unclear. However, I do remember that it was guarded by some dragons made of solid mithril.

the-ultimate-weapon-before-forging-the-k.player: Hmm... I'll see what I can find.

the-ultimate-weapon-talking-to-bob.speaker: Bob
the-ultimate-weapon-talking-to-bob.text: Now that I've started to regain my memories, I find myself hungry for answers. I'd like to see for myself what these doors guard.

the-ultimate-weapon-talking-to-bob.player: Well we'll be finding out very soon. I've managed to fix the key.

the-ultimate-weapon-talking-to-bob.speaker: Bob
the-ultimate-weapon-talking-to-bob.text: Let's see if it works then.

the-ultimate-weapon-talking-to-dallas.player: I've managed to repair the key.

the-ultimate-weapon-talking-to-dallas.speaker: Dallas Jones
the-ultimate-weapon-talking-to-dallas.text: Well no point waiting around. Let's get these doors open.

the-ultimate-weapon-talking-to-either-in.speaker: Dallas Jones
the-ultimate-weapon-talking-to-either-in.text: That is one big dragon!

the-ultimate-weapon-talking-to-either-in.speaker: Bob
the-ultimate-weapon-talking-to-either-in.text: This isn't right... We've made a mistake. We need to leave now!
A cutscene begins. The camera pans towards the sleeping dragon, with the player, Bob, and Dallas seen from behind.

the-ultimate-weapon-talking-to-either-in.speaker: Mysterious Voice
the-ultimate-weapon-talking-to-either-in.text: Magnificent isn't he?

the-ultimate-weapon-talking-to-either-in.speaker: Mysterious Voice
the-ultimate-weapon-talking-to-either-in.text: His name is Galvek. In our tongue, it means...
The player, Bob, and Dallas turn around as camera pans towards the voice, revealing a dragonkin.

the-ultimate-weapon-talking-to-either-in.speaker: Dragonkin
the-ultimate-weapon-talking-to-either-in.text: Fate.
The cutscene ends.

the-ultimate-weapon-talking-to-either-in.speaker: Bob
the-ultimate-weapon-talking-to-either-in.text: You! I remember you. Zorgoth.

the-ultimate-weapon-talking-to-either-in.speaker: Zorgoth
the-ultimate-weapon-talking-to-either-in.text: Hello, Robert. You've had quite the makeover.

the-ultimate-weapon-talking-to-either-in.speaker: Bob
the-ultimate-weapon-talking-to-either-in.text: You should be dead.

the-ultimate-weapon-talking-to-either-in.speaker: Zorgoth
the-ultimate-weapon-talking-to-either-in.text: We dragonkin are not as flimsy as you. I'm afraid you failed.

the-ultimate-weapon-talking-to-either-in.speaker: Zorgoth
the-ultimate-weapon-talking-to-either-in.text: Ah, I see you brought your friend with you. I'm surprised to see you here after all this time. Curious...

the-ultimate-weapon-talking-to-either-in.speaker: Dallas Jones
the-ultimate-weapon-talking-to-either-in.text: Hello there, dragonkin.

the-ultimate-weapon-talking-to-either-in.speaker: Zorgoth
the-ultimate-weapon-talking-to-either-in.text: You I don't recognise. Who are you?

the-ultimate-weapon-talking-to-either-in.speaker: Dallas Jones
the-ultimate-weapon-talking-to-either-in.text: I'm Dallas Jones, and I came here for answers.

the-ultimate-weapon-talking-to-either-in.speaker: Zorgoth
the-ultimate-weapon-talking-to-either-in.text: Is that so? Then tell me, Dallas Jones, what answers do you seek?

the-ultimate-weapon-talking-to-either-in.speaker: Dallas Jones
the-ultimate-weapon-talking-to-either-in.text: I want to know the truth about Elvarg, about Crandor.

the-ultimate-weapon-talking-to-either-in.speaker: Zorgoth
the-ultimate-weapon-talking-to-either-in.text: Elvarg? Crandor? These names mean nothing to me.

the-ultimate-weapon-talking-to-either-in.player: Elvarg was a dragon who attacked the island of Crandor. We found a lab hidden in her lair. We followed the clues and they led us here, to you.

the-ultimate-weapon-talking-to-either-in.speaker: Zorgoth
the-ultimate-weapon-talking-to-either-in.text: You gave her a name? I never bothered. She was nothing.

the-ultimate-weapon-talking-to-either-in.speaker: Bob
the-ultimate-weapon-talking-to-either-in.text: Nothing? What do you mean?

the-ultimate-weapon-talking-to-either-in.speaker: Zorgoth
the-ultimate-weapon-talking-to-either-in.text: After your failed attempt on my life, I realised that we were starting to lose the war against your kind. We needed to turn the tide. We needed a new weapon.

the-ultimate-weapon-talking-to-either-in.speaker: Zorgoth
the-ultimate-weapon-talking-to-either-in.text: The creature you call Elvarg was the first. An attempt to create a being which would crush humanity once and for all. She was a failure. Too weak. Pathetic.

the-ultimate-weapon-talking-to-either-in.speaker: Zorgoth
the-ultimate-weapon-talking-to-either-in.text: We moved on. We tried various other methods, all ending in disappointment. In the end, we came here. Our largest facility yet. Here we began work on what would become our masterpiece.

the-ultimate-weapon-talking-to-either-in.speaker: Bob
the-ultimate-weapon-talking-to-either-in.text: But we got here first.

the-ultimate-weapon-talking-to-either-in.speaker: Zorgoth
the-ultimate-weapon-talking-to-either-in.text: An annoying setback. When you attacked, I had this place sealed, to keep our work safe. My people were to return after the attack and release me again.

the-ultimate-weapon-talking-to-either-in.speaker: Bob
the-ultimate-weapon-talking-to-either-in.text: But we killed them before they could leave.

the-ultimate-weapon-talking-to-either-in.speaker: Zorgoth
the-ultimate-weapon-talking-to-either-in.text: I suspected as much. However, it turned out quite well for me in the end. I have been sealed here for hundreds of years, alone and without disturbance. More than enough time for me to perfect our salvation.

the-ultimate-weapon-talking-to-either-in.speaker: Zorgoth
the-ultimate-weapon-talking-to-either-in.text: Yes. He has power that no other dragon has. The power to influence the minds of other dragons. Through him, an army will be raised. One that will annihilate humanity.

the-ultimate-weapon-talking-to-either-in.speaker: Dallas Jones
the-ultimate-weapon-talking-to-either-in.text: Why?

the-ultimate-weapon-talking-to-either-in.speaker: Zorgoth
the-ultimate-weapon-talking-to-either-in.text: Why? You attacked us. Tried to destroy us. You took away our homes, our people. Were we expected to stand by and watch?

the-ultimate-weapon-talking-to-either-in.speaker: Bob
the-ultimate-weapon-talking-to-either-in.text: We were defending ourselves. You threatened to destroy us all.

the-ultimate-weapon-talking-to-either-in.speaker: Zorgoth
the-ultimate-weapon-talking-to-either-in.text: Not all of us. Only a few gave in to the anger of the curse. Only a few waged war on you. But you were not willing to distinguish. And now, neither am I.

the-ultimate-weapon-talking-to-either-in.speaker: Zorgoth
the-ultimate-weapon-talking-to-either-in.text: Humanity is a disease. You have just unleashed the cure.

the-ultimate-weapon-talking-to-either-in.player: Do you really think we're letting you leave this place?

the-ultimate-weapon-talking-to-either-in.speaker: Zorgoth
the-ultimate-weapon-talking-to-either-in.text: I don't think you have a choice. Let me show you...

the-ultimate-weapon-talking-to-either-in.speaker: Zorgoth
the-ultimate-weapon-talking-to-either-in.text: Awaken!
A cutscene begins, the screen shaking. The ceiling begins to crumble as debris falls onto the floor.

the-ultimate-weapon-talking-to-either-in.speaker: Bob
the-ultimate-weapon-talking-to-either-in.text: It's moving!
Galvek is awakened off-camera, and attacks Dallas, killing him instantly.

the-ultimate-weapon-talking-to-either-in.speaker: Dallas Jones
the-ultimate-weapon-talking-to-either-in.text: Aaargh!

the-ultimate-weapon-talking-to-either-in.speaker: Bob
the-ultimate-weapon-talking-to-either-in.text: Meow!
The player carries Bob and runs toward the camera.

the-ultimate-weapon-talking-to-either-in.speaker: Both
the-ultimate-weapon-talking-to-either-in.text: Aaargh!
The camera pans towards Galvek, now moving towards the camera. The scene then cuts to the player and Bob, the former performing the panic emote.

the-ultimate-weapon-talking-to-either-in.speaker: Bob
the-ultimate-weapon-talking-to-either-in.text: We'd better go!
The scene transitions to Jardric by the Ancient Doors, where debris continues falling onto the floor.

the-ultimate-weapon-talking-to-either-in.speaker: Jardric
the-ultimate-weapon-talking-to-either-in.text: What's happening?
The scene transitions to Galvek and Zorgoth, preparing their grand escape.

the-ultimate-weapon-talking-to-either-in.speaker: Jardric
the-ultimate-weapon-talking-to-either-in.text: Aaargh!
Jardric fires his crossbow at Galvek.

the-ultimate-weapon-talking-to-either-in.speaker: Zorgoth
the-ultimate-weapon-talking-to-either-in.text: You dare!
Zorgoth casts stun on Jardric, knocking him back off-camera.

the-ultimate-weapon-talking-to-either-in.speaker: Zorgoth
the-ultimate-weapon-talking-to-either-in.text: The doors are unlocked! Release us!

The camera pans to Galvek from behind facing the Ancient Doors, firing a large blast of fire that covers the screen. The scene transitions to outside the Ancient Doors, and Galvek flies upwards, ending the cutscene.

the-ultimate-weapon-talking-to-either-in.speaker: Jardric
the-ultimate-weapon-talking-to-either-in.text: That really hurt!

the-ultimate-weapon-talking-to-either-in.speaker: Bob
the-ultimate-weapon-talking-to-either-in.text: It looks like we may have a slight problem on our hands.

the-ultimate-weapon-talking-to-either-in.player: What do we do? That dragonkin said he was going to assemble an army of dragons!

the-ultimate-weapon-talking-to-either-in.speaker: Jardric
the-ultimate-weapon-talking-to-either-in.text: This is too much for just us to deal with. We're going to need some help.

the-ultimate-weapon-talking-to-either-in.speaker: Jardric
the-ultimate-weapon-talking-to-either-in.text: King Roald commands one of the largest armies in the world. He's probably a good starting point.

the-ultimate-weapon-talking-to-either-in.player: Good plan. I'll go see the King.

the-ultimate-weapon-talking-to-either-in.speaker: Jardric
the-ultimate-weapon-talking-to-either-in.text: And I'll get in touch with Keldagrim. Maybe they can help us.

the-ultimate-weapon-talking-to-either-in.speaker: Bob
the-ultimate-weapon-talking-to-either-in.text: Good luck, [player name].
Bob and Jardric depart.

steps.player: Greetings, your majesty.

steps.speaker: King Roald
steps.text: Hello there. Do you need something?

steps.player: I'm here to talk about dragons.

steps.speaker: King Roald
steps.text: If you mean the dragons that have been spotted flying around, we're well aware. I have my best people investigating this and we will make sure the citizens are safe. Now, be on your way.

steps.player: Wait! I know what the dragons are doing.

steps.speaker: King Roald
steps.text: You do?

steps.player: Yes. There's a dragonkin named Zorgoth who has managed to bring them under his control. He is forming an army which he intends to use to attack humanity!

steps.speaker: King Roald
steps.text: A dragonkin? That's preposterous. The dragonkin have been dead for hundreds of years.

steps.player: I know it sounds crazy, but you have to believe me! Why else would the dragons be acting so odd?

steps.speaker: King Roald
steps.text: Well I suppose you've been a friend to Varrock in the past. What would you ask of us?

steps.player: You need to gather your soldiers. We have to destroy this dragon threat before it destroys us.

steps.speaker: Aeonisig Raispher
steps.text: Gather the soldiers? My lord, do you know what this means?

steps.speaker: King Roald
steps.text: Of course I know what it means. But this citizen is right, we have no choice.

steps.speaker: Aeonisig Raispher
steps.text: But my lord...
If the player has not completed Darkness of Hallowvale:

steps.speaker: King Roald
steps.text: Enough. This enemy is threatening us directly and we must respond.
If the player has completed Darkness of Hallowvale:

steps.speaker: King Roald
steps.text: Enough. This isn't like Morytania. There is no godly involvement here. This enemy is threatening us directly and we must respond.

steps.speaker: King Roald
steps.text: I will make the necessary preparations. In the meantime, citizen, you will visit King [Lathas/Thoros], Chieftain Brundt and Sir Amik Varze. Tell them to come to Varrock to discuss the dragon threat.

steps.speaker: Aeonisig Raispher
steps.text: Chieftain Brundt? You would ally with those barbarians?

steps.speaker: King Roald
steps.text: For Saradomin's sake! They have ships and they have soldiers! We need them on our side.
If the player has completed Regicide but has not completed Song of the Elves:

steps.player: I'm not sure if we want King Lathas on our side.

steps.speaker: King Roald
steps.text: You as well? Put your petty disagreements aside and look at the big picture. We must all work together if we are to survive.

steps.player: I guess you're right.

steps.speaker: King Roald
steps.text: Now, you should get moving. Time is not on our side. While you're gone, I'll have Aeonisig reach out to some other people as well. We need all the help we can get.

steps.player: Greetings, your majesty.

steps.speaker: King Roald
steps.text: Hello there. Have you spoken to the other leaders yet?

steps.player: Not yet. Who am I meant to be speaking to again?

steps.speaker: King Roald
steps.text: Talk to King [Lathas/Thoros], Chieftain Brundt and Sir Amik Varze. Tell them that they are needed in Varrock to discuss the dragon threat. Now hurry up and get it done.

steps.player: Hello, Sir Amik.

steps.speaker: Sir Amik Varze
steps.text: Hello there. What can I do for you?

steps.player: I'm here to talk about dragons.

steps.speaker: Sir Amik Varze
steps.text: I assume you mean all these dragons that have been flying around. Do you know something?

steps.player: I do. It's not good I'm afraid. The dragons are uniting under a dragonkin named Zorgoth. He intends to use them against us.

steps.speaker: Sir Amik Varze
steps.text: I thought all the dragonkin were dead!

steps.player: I'm afraid not.

steps.speaker: Sir Amik Varze
steps.text: History says they are a formidable enemy. Do you have a plan to combat this threat?

steps.player: King Roald is forming an army to take on the dragons. He's requested your presence in Varrock to discuss this.

steps.speaker: Sir Amik Varze
steps.text: Very well, I shall head to Varrock. Thank you for passing on this message.

steps.player: Hello, Sir Amik.

steps.speaker: Sir Amik Varze
steps.text: Hello there. I will be leaving for Varrock soon.

steps.player: I'll see you there.
Good day my lord.

steps.speaker: King Lathas
steps.text: Greetings. Do you require something?

steps.player: I wanted to talk to you about some dragons.

steps.speaker: King Lathas
steps.text: We've had various reports come in about a sudden increase in dragon activity. I assume this is what you're referring to?

steps.player: It is. The increase in activity is caused by a dragonkin called Zorgoth. He's forming an army of dragons to destroy humanity with.

steps.speaker: King Lathas
steps.text: I see. I will ensure our forces are ready to fight back against this threat.

steps.player: You need not fight it alone. King Roald is preparing his own men and would like you to fight with him. A meeting is to be held in Varrock to plan the defence.

steps.speaker: King Lathas
steps.text: An alliance with King Roald? Interesting. We have no quarrel with Misthalin. I accept.

steps.player: Great. I'll see you in Varrock.

a-world-united-talking-to-king-lathas-th.speaker: King Thoros
a-world-united-talking-to-king-lathas-th.text: On behalf of everyone in Ardougne, I thank you for your help adventurer. I'm afraid I don't have time to talk, my predecessor has left me with a lot of work to do.

steps.player: I appreciate you're busy, but I wanted to talk to you about some dragons.

steps.speaker: King Thoros
steps.text: We've had various reports come in about a sudden increase in dragon activity. I assume this is what you're referring to?

a-world-united-talking-to-king-lathas-th.speaker: King Thoros
a-world-united-talking-to-king-lathas-th.text: On behalf of everyone in Ardougne, I thank you for your help adventurer. I'm afraid I don't have time to talk, my predecessor has left me with a lot of work to do.

steps.player: I appreciate you're busy, but I wanted to talk to you about some dragons.

steps.speaker: King Thoros
steps.text: Don't worry, I'm preparing for my departure to Varrock.

steps.player: Fair enough. I'll see you there.

options.text: Ask about a Seal of Passage.

steps.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
steps.text: Greetings, [Fremennik name]. Have you seen those beasts flying towards Ungael? Might be best to stay clear of that place for a while.

steps.player: Hello, Brundt. That's what I wanted to talk to you about.

steps.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
steps.text: Let me guess, you intend to take these beasts on?

steps.player: I do.

steps.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
steps.text: You are a true warrior, [Fremennik name], though I fear this may be too much even for you. You are heavily outnumbered.

steps.player: I don't plan on doing it alone. I have the support of King Roald. I was hoping you'd help as well.

steps.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
steps.text: Fight alongside outerlanders? That is not typically our way, [Fremennik name].

steps.player: I understand. However, these dragons are threatening humanity as a whole. We must fight back.

steps.text: If the player is not exiled:

steps.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
steps.text: Well let it not be said that the Fremennik turned away from a good fight. You have our support. Maybe we'll show your outerlander friends a thing or two!
If the player is exiled:

steps.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
steps.text: The council won't be happy. I'll tell them we're doing it to show your outerlander friends how to fight. That should convince them.

steps.player: Thanks, Brundt. There is to be a meeting in Varrock to discuss our plan of action. It would be good if you could attend.

steps.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
steps.text: Pah! Outerlanders and their meetings. I will attend, but this better not take long. We have dragons to kill!

options.text: Ask about a Seal of Passage.

steps.player: Hello, Brundt. Are you ready for the meeting in Varrock.

steps.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
steps.text: I shall be heading there soon, [Fremennik name].

steps.player: In that case, I'll see you there.

a-world-united-talking-to-bob-before-the.player: I've arranged a meeting with King Roald and some other rulers. We're going to discuss how to combat the dragons.

a-world-united-talking-to-bob-before-the.speaker: Bob
a-world-united-talking-to-bob-before-the.text: It's not the dragons I'm worried about, [player name]. It's Zorgoth.

a-world-united-talking-to-bob-before-the.speaker: Bob
a-world-united-talking-to-bob-before-the.text: I hope you're right. You'd better head in and get this meeting done. Come talk to me once it's finished. There's something we need to discuss.

a-world-united-talking-to-jardric-before.speaker: Jardric
a-world-united-talking-to-jardric-before.text: Hello there. While you were arranging this meeting I spoke to the Consortium in Keldagrim. I'm afraid they won't be helping us.

a-world-united-talking-to-jardric-before.player: Well we still have Roald and the other rulers.

a-world-united-talking-to-jardric-before.speaker: Jardric
a-world-united-talking-to-jardric-before.text: Indeed. Speaking of which, you should head on in. The meeting will be starting soon.

steps.player: Greetings, your majesty.

steps.speaker: King Roald
steps.text: Good work gathering the other leaders. The meeting will begin shortly. Head into the dining room when you are ready.

a-world-united-meeting-between-leaders.speaker: King Roald
a-world-united-meeting-between-leaders.text: Thank you all for coming. As I'm sure you are aware, we are facing one of the greatest threats ever seen in our time.

a-world-united-meeting-between-leaders.speaker: King Roald
a-world-united-meeting-between-leaders.text: Our job here is to decide upon a solution and then enact it.
If the player has not completed Song of the Elves:

steps.speaker: King Lathas
steps.text: The solution is clear. We need to take these dragons head on and destroy them.

steps.speaker: King Arthur
steps.text: Careful Lathas. I have seen the horrors of war first hand. This is not something we should merrily jump into.

steps.speaker: King Lathas
steps.text: And what would the great King Arthur have us do? Would you cower in fear while these dragons annihilate those around you?

steps.speaker: King Roald
steps.text: Enough!

a-world-united-meeting-between-leaders.text: If the player has completed Song of the Elves:

steps.speaker: King Thoros
steps.text: With our forces united, we should have the strength to take on these dragons and destroy them.

a-world-united-meeting-between-leaders.speaker: King Roald
a-world-united-meeting-between-leaders.text: I take no joy in it, but war may be the only option here. If even half of what history says is true, the dragonkin are merciless.

a-world-united-meeting-between-leaders.speaker: Sir Tiffy Cashien
a-world-united-meeting-between-leaders.text: Before this meeting, I thought I'd have a good old rummage around in our archives. I'm afraid the old bean is right. War is inevitable.

a-world-united-meeting-between-leaders.speaker: Denulth
a-world-united-meeting-between-leaders.text: With all due respect, how can we be sure that this is the work of a dragonkin? I trust [player name] as much as anyone, but what if there was a mistake?

a-world-united-meeting-between-leaders.speaker: Jardric
a-world-united-meeting-between-leaders.text: It's no mistake. I saw it myself.

a-world-united-meeting-between-leaders.speaker: Oneiromancer
a-world-united-meeting-between-leaders.text: They speak the truth.

a-world-united-meeting-between-leaders.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
a-world-united-meeting-between-leaders.text: Let me guess, you used your magic to work that one out?

a-world-united-meeting-between-leaders.speaker: Oneiromancer
a-world-united-meeting-between-leaders.text: Careful, Brundt, I am not the enemy here.

a-world-united-meeting-between-leaders.speaker: Sir Amik Varze
a-world-united-meeting-between-leaders.text: If we are agreed that the threat is real, may I suggest we get to work on solving it rather than bickering amongst ourselves.

a-world-united-meeting-between-leaders.speaker: Denulth
a-world-united-meeting-between-leaders.text: As much as I hate to agree with a White Knight, he's right. We need to work together if we are going to survive.

a-world-united-meeting-between-leaders.speaker: King Roald
a-world-united-meeting-between-leaders.text: So what do we do?

a-world-united-meeting-between-leaders.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
a-world-united-meeting-between-leaders.text: The dragons are amassing at Ungael. We should take the fight to them and destroy the danger before it leaves that island!

a-world-united-meeting-between-leaders.speaker: King Arthur
a-world-united-meeting-between-leaders.text: That would keep the fight away from any innocents, but it would be a great risk.

a-world-united-meeting-between-leaders.speaker: Sir Amik Varze
a-world-united-meeting-between-leaders.text: Indeed. Boats do not do well against dragonfire.

a-world-united-meeting-between-leaders.speaker: King Roald
a-world-united-meeting-between-leaders.text: The citizens must take priority. If we have an opportunity to keep the danger away from them, we should take it.

a-world-united-meeting-between-leaders.speaker: Sir Tiffy Cashien
a-world-united-meeting-between-leaders.text: Well said, fellow. Well said indeed.

a-world-united-meeting-between-leaders.speaker: King Lathas/Thoros
a-world-united-meeting-between-leaders.text: So we amass the fleets?

a-world-united-meeting-between-leaders.speaker: King Roald
a-world-united-meeting-between-leaders.text: We do. Unless anyone has any complaints. [player name]? You've been very quiet throughout this. What are your thoughts?

steps.player: It's a good plan.
It's a bad plan.

steps.speaker: King Roald
steps.text: I fear we don't have a choice. The risks are great, but they were always going to be with a threat like this.

steps.speaker: Denulth
steps.text: He's right. This is the only option.

a-world-united-meeting-between-leaders.speaker: King Roald
a-world-united-meeting-between-leaders.text: Then we are agreed. This room contains some of the most powerful people in the world. Heroes and rulers alike. We may be the only thing that stands in the way of annihilation.

a-world-united-meeting-between-leaders.speaker: King Roald
a-world-united-meeting-between-leaders.text: We may not all like each other, and some of us have a checkered history, but we will work together to destroy this enemy.

a-world-united-meeting-between-leaders.speaker: King Roald
a-world-united-meeting-between-leaders.text: Good luck to us all.

a-world-united-meeting-between-leaders.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
a-world-united-meeting-between-leaders.text: You should join us for this fight, [Fremennik name]. Torfinn will take you to the fleet when you are ready.

a-world-united-meeting-between-leaders.speaker: Bob
a-world-united-meeting-between-leaders.text: Could I have a word with you outside, [player name]? There's something we need to discuss.
The player automatically exits the meeting.

a-world-united-meeting-between-leaders.speaker: Bob
a-world-united-meeting-between-leaders.text: Hello, [player name]. We need to talk about Zorgoth.

a-world-united-meeting-between-leaders.speaker: Bob
a-world-united-meeting-between-leaders.text: He is the real threat here. You can kill as many dragons as you want in this battle, but it won't be over until Zorgoth himself is dealt with.

a-world-united-meeting-between-leaders.speaker: Bob
a-world-united-meeting-between-leaders.text: Dragonkin are not easy to kill. In fact, they are immune to most weapons. But Zorgoth made it clear that Galvek is the key to his plan. The only reason he has this army is because of that dragon.

a-world-united-meeting-between-leaders.speaker: Bob
a-world-united-meeting-between-leaders.text: Yes. Without Galvek, Zorgoth has nothing. Removing his army is the only chance of stopping him. It must be done, no matter the cost.

a-world-united-meeting-between-leaders.speaker: Bob
a-world-united-meeting-between-leaders.text: It won't, but I have faith in you, [player name]. Now you'd better head to the fleet. I'll see you in Rellekka.

a-world-united-meeting-between-leaders.speaker: Bob
a-world-united-meeting-between-leaders.text: I am. I can't fight any more, but I know a lot about the dragonkin. I might be able to use that knowledge to help. Besides, much of this is my fault, so it's only right that I help fix it. Now let's get going.

steps.player: Greetings, your majesty.

steps.speaker: King Roald
steps.text: Our armies are preparing for the assault on Ungael. Speak to Torfinn in Rellekka when you are ready, he will take you to the fleet.

the-assault-talking-to-torfinn.text: If the player is not exiled:

steps.speaker: Torfinn
steps.text: Good day to you, [Fremennik name]. Do you want to go to the fleet?

steps.speaker: Torfinn
steps.text: I'm not meant to be talking to you [Fremennik name]. I guess I can still take you to the fleet though if you want.

steps.player: Yes please.

steps.text: A cutscene begins. The scene shows the various ships of the global allied fleet, then showing the ship that the player, Brundt, Koschei, and Thorvald are on.

steps.speaker: Thorvald the Warrior
steps.text: Alert!
The scene shows a green, red, and blue dragon launching dragonfire towards the ship, beginning the first part of the assault.

options.text: Do you have any of my items?

steps.player: Do you have any of my items?

steps.speaker: Torfinn
steps.text: I'm afraid not [Fremennik name]. If I did have any of your items, but you died before collecting them, they'll now be lost.

steps.player: No thank you.

the-assault-crashing-the-ship.text: A cutscene begins. The scene shows the ship the player is on.

the-assault-crashing-the-ship.speaker: Thorvald the Warrior
the-assault-crashing-the-ship.text: I can see the island! We're almost there!
The ship is bombarded with dragonfire, and the screen fades to black.

the-assault-crashing-the-ship.speaker: Koschei the Deathless
the-assault-crashing-the-ship.text: Time to wake up, [Fremennik name]. You have dragons to slay!

the-assault-crashing-the-ship.speaker: Koschei the Deathless
the-assault-crashing-the-ship.text: They went on ahead. You should catch up. I'll cover the rear.

the-assault-talking-to-bob-on-varrock-s-.speaker: Bob
the-assault-talking-to-bob-on-varrock-s-.text: [player name]! Thank goodness you're here. We've got ourselves into quite the situation.

the-assault-talking-to-bob-on-varrock-s-.player: What do we do? We're never going to make it to the island now.

the-assault-talking-to-bob-on-varrock-s-.speaker: Bob
the-assault-talking-to-bob-on-varrock-s-.text: We'll have to worry about that later. For now, you'll need to take out these dragons.

the-assault-talking-to-bob-on-varrock-s-.speaker: Bob
the-assault-talking-to-bob-on-varrock-s-.text: No time to talk, [player name]. Get out there and kill those dragons.

the-assault-arrival-of-zorgoth-and-galve.text: A cutscene begins. The scene shows Galvek landing on the ship, instantly killing the four remaining soldiers. Bob walks forward and stops next to you, just as Zorgoth arrives.

the-assault-arrival-of-zorgoth-and-galve.speaker: Zorgoth
the-assault-arrival-of-zorgoth-and-galve.text: Well look who it is. I see you're still alive.

the-assault-arrival-of-zorgoth-and-galve.speaker: Zorgoth
the-assault-arrival-of-zorgoth-and-galve.text: You should have stayed at home. You're not a warrior anymore.

the-assault-arrival-of-zorgoth-and-galve.speaker: Bob
the-assault-arrival-of-zorgoth-and-galve.text: Maybe not, but I'm right where I need to be.
Galvek launches dragonfire toward the player, but Bob jumps in the way and is instantly killed.
A black dragon lands, and the cutscene ends.

the-assault-the-heroes-arrive.text: After defeating the black, steel, and brutal red dragons, a cutscene begins. The scene shows a mithril dragon landing between the player and Zorgoth.

the-assault-the-heroes-arrive.speaker: Zorgoth
the-assault-the-heroes-arrive.text: Why do you persist? Can't you see you've already lost?

the-assault-the-heroes-arrive.speaker: Zorgoth
the-assault-the-heroes-arrive.text: Your precious hero is gone! Your friends have abandoned you!
The camera pans towards Achietties, Brundt, the Wise Old Man, Sir Tiffy, the Oneiromancer, and Jardric, who have come to your aid.

the-assault-the-final-fight-begins.text: After killing the mithril, adamant, and rune dragons, a cutscene begins.

the-assault-the-final-fight-begins.speaker: Zorgoth
the-assault-the-final-fight-begins.text: Enough of this! You've had your fun! But that fun is at an end!

the-assault-the-final-fight-begins.speaker: Zorgoth
the-assault-the-final-fight-begins.text: You will now face the full might of my power!
The camera pans towards all the heroes, and a pair of brutal black dragons land behind them.

the-assault-the-final-fight-begins.speaker: Sir Tiffy Cashien
the-assault-the-final-fight-begins.text: We've got your back, [player name]. Now you show that dragon what for!

the-assault-the-final-fight-begins.speaker: Zorgoth
the-assault-the-final-fight-begins.text: Yes, come on, Dragon Slayer. Let's see what you've got.

the-assault-end-of-the-battle.text: A cutscene begins. Galvek dies, falling backwards. With their literal, last dying (dragon)breath, accidentally kills Zorgoth by coincidence.
The heroes walk towards the player.
The scene changes to Burthorpe, where the player, Unferth, and Neite mourn the loss of Bob at his grave.
If the player attempts to talk to Neite:

steps.text: It looks like Neite would rather be alone right now.

finishing-up.speaker: Alec Kincade
finishing-up.text: Greetings adventurer. Welcome to the Myths' Guild.

steps.player: Let's talk about my quest.

steps.speaker: Alec Kincade
steps.text: I hear we have a hero in our midst. You have faced one of the greatest threats this world has ever seen and come out victorious.

steps.player: Not without losses though.

steps.speaker: Alec Kincade
steps.text: Indeed. We will ensure their sacrifice is never forgotten.

steps.speaker: Alec Kincade
steps.text: All that remains is to ensure that history will forever remember this day. Now, tell me everything.
You tell Alec about your quest and all that you discovered.

steps.speaker: Alec Kincade
steps.text: Thank you friend. You have helped us to fill our Library of Knowledge. The secrets that you have uncovered are worth more than any coin. It is an honour to welcome you into the Myths' Guild.
If the player has not completed While Guthix Sleeps:
If the player has completed While Guthix Sleeps:

Meanwhile, a cutscene plays in the Lithkren Vault, with the camera slowly approaching the pool where Galvek once rested. The camera pans toward the strange tube to the east. A mysterious gas envelopes the dragonkin within, awakening it and breaking out. At the same time, the strange tube to the west also breaks, revealing two more dragonkin as they all convene by the pool.

steps.speaker: Sakirth
steps.text: Zorgoth?

steps.speaker: Sithaph
steps.text: Dead.

steps.speaker: Strisath
steps.text: Then we are free at last!

steps.speaker: Sakirth
steps.text: And a strength grows within us!

steps.speaker: Sithaph
steps.text: The Stone has been uncovered. The mortals try to claim its power.

steps.speaker: Sakirth
steps.text: Then let us bring terror and pain to them!

steps.speaker: Strisath
steps.text: Yes! The dragonkin will rise once more!

-fDz0m.speaker: Oneiromancer
-fDz0m.text: You'll need to make some room in your inventory for this vial. Come back to me when you have.
